notes.title: Orc Covenant: Yurl's Redemption OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43333130/a9d0d5a5fe9b0d9cf16be30622cde1b61e5725db.png[/img]

[h1]Orc Covenant Yurl's Redemption is Available Now![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375760/Orc_Covenant_Yurls_Redemption/]Buy Now to Catch the Launch Discount! CLICK HERE![/url]

Yurl carries the heavy weight of regret over his crime against the orc tribe 20 years ago.  He's settled for a life of exile, grateful his son Karn is speaking to him again.  The lascivious orc he once was is long gone, buried under tons of guilt.

Keoni is an Arch-Mage devoted to his sex god.  He partakes in regular sex rituals to please his god and increase his magic.  But these are always short trysts, one-time affairs.  He longs to have a permanent partner to share his magic with.

Can mage and orc come together to right old wrongs and find what's missing from both their lives?

[list]
[*]  A 1.5 to 2 Hour 15,000 Word DLC!

[*] Loaded with Nine Pin-Up CGs and Additional CG Variations!

[/list]

Click 'Extra' on the Menu to access the DLC!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375760/Orc_Covenant_Yurls_Redemption/]This DLC gives us a Yurl route to the game.[/url]  Play as the Arch-Mage Keoni and make the right decisions to help both Yurl and yourself!

notes.title: More Color Scenes Added!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the September 2024 Patch Notes for Orc Covenant! [/h1] 
[h2]You can expect to see one of these every month going forward into 2025.[/h2]

[h3]This Month:[/h3]

[list]
[*] There was a new scene added to the beginning (demo) portion of the game during Xareth's "guantlet".  This scene is between Dagroth's best friend Brogrash and Xareth. Be sure to check it out if you haven't played the demo in a while! It takes place toward the end of the guantlet, before Xareth is in the puddle. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43333130/275d460c4ce7f55261ebe5954500968e4aabef67.png[/img]

[*] A new scene was added to the Yundril route featuring Brogrash and Galen. This is after Xareth's double seduces Kurdan and Galen catches them.  Any choice tree will eventually bring you to this scene.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43333130/6fc5cf108bc3294cfff50c7576b147e981be7a85.png[/img]

[*] A new scene was added to the Kurdan route between Dagroth and Brogrash! Orc on orc!  To get this scene you'll want to pick Kurdan and follow the options for the House Slave ending:
1.	I can manipulate him to give a prediction in my favor.
2.	We’ll leave.
3.	Do nothing yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43333130/bd236429bf89a24abe9f9876b99ce4802b7849bf.png[/img]

[*] Additional improvements were made to address typos or logic errors. If you spot any more please contact us and let us know!

[*] We changed the auto-voice feature to work with Steam Deck.
[/list]

These scenes were added throughout August and September. To get instant updates about new game content just join our [url=https://discord.gg/KyhMvJg]Discord[/url] and check the Orc Covenant channel!

Brogrash has one more scene coming and then we'll be bringing you numerous other scenes with several other different characters over the coming months!  Each month will give you a reason to crack open the game again and check out the new spicey content and additional story features!

[b]To get to the new scenes, go to settings and set 'Skipping' to 'Read Text'. Now you can hold down the Ctrl key (Command key on Apple) or click the Skip button on the dialogue box (for Steam Deck).  It should automatically stop at new or edited content.[/b]
